q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis of NVIDIA's Q2 FY2027 Forward Guidance

## (a) Time left until resolution

Today is August 17, 2026. Q2 FY2027 ends on July 31, 2026, which means Q2 has already concluded. The earnings release and forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 was already announced on May 20, 2026 (as stated in the research). 

**This question is asking about a forward guidance that has already been issued.** The resolution date has passed.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

According to the CURRENT RESEARCH provided, NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue, released on May 20, 2026, is **$91.0 billion ± 2%**.

This means:
- Midpoint: $91.0 billion
- Range: $89.18 billion to $92.82 billion (91.0 ± 2%)

Since this guidance was already issued and the quarter is complete, the "forward guidance" that NVIDIA provided is known and fixed at $91.0 billion (with the ±2% range indicating their confidence band).

The consensus estimate mentioned was $91.846 billion, which was slightly higher than NVIDIA's own guidance.

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- Weaker than expected demand for AI compute
- Supply chain disruptions affecting production
- Lower pricing realization than anticipated
- Geopolitical restrictions impacting addressable market (notably China Data Center restrictions mentioned)
- Macro headwinds reducing customer spending

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- Stronger demand for AI compute exceeding expectations
- Higher pricing power than anticipated
- Successful market share gains
- Upside from hyperscaler cloud spending
- Potential loosening of China export restrictions
- Better product mix (higher-margin products)

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

The research explicitly states that NVIDIA reported **record revenue of $81.6 billion for Q1 FY2027**, representing an 85% year-over-year increase. The guidance of $91.0 billion for Q2 FY2027 represents approximately a 12% quarter-over-quarter increase from Q1, which represents a decelerating growth rate compared to recent trends but remains exceptionally strong.

No other historical base rates are provided in the materials.

---

## Final Estimate

Given that NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 was officially released at **$91.0 billion ± 2%**, and this is a factual statement of what the company publicly guided to, the most likely outcome is that this is the number being asked about. The guidance range is $89.18 billion to $92.82 billion.

The question asks "What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance" — phrased as future tense, but the guidance has already been issued. The answer provided in the research is definitive: $91.0 billion with a ±2% range.

Applying the ±2% confidence band symmetrically around the $91.0 billion midpoint:

Low (10th percentile): 89180000000
Median (50th percentile): 91000000000
High (90th percentile): 92820000000

NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue, released on May 20, 2026, is an expected $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [nvidianews.nvidia.com](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-fiscal-2027/). This guidance does not include any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027/). The consensus revenue estimate for Q2 FY2027 is slightly higher at $91.846 billion [hudson-labs.com](https://www.hudson-labs.com/research/nvidia-q2-2027-earnings-preview-nvda-revenue-guidance-key-factors/).

For Q2 FY2027, NVIDIA also projects GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins of 74.9% and 75.0% respectively (plus or minus 50 basis points) [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/). Operating expenses are anticipated to be approximately $8.5 billion (GAAP) and $8.3 billion (non-GAAP) [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/). The company reported record revenue of $81.6 billion for Q1 FY2027, an 85% increase year-over-year [hudson-labs.com](https://www.hudson-labs.com/research/nvidia-q2-2027-earnings-preview-nvda-revenue-guidance-key-factors/).
